source_decisions: The intro and m4/38/54/79 onsets were independently read from the original PDF before comparison with mixed-audio transients.
Only one fixed tempo and first-beat offset is used. Window shifts and peak deltas are diagnostics, never individual playback beat corrections.
The half-quarter pulse search covers played quarters 16..371.5. Canonical XML ORDER must agree with the reviewed repeat/ending sequence.
117 BPM is the printed tempo. Search ranges and anchors apply only to the source audio hash recorded here; 116.999 BPM does not establish a meaningful deviation from 117.
These inputs reproduce the original numerical analysis. They do not imply actual listening, source instrument isolation or count-off playback verification.
report_method: Common three-band spectral flux; fixed half-quarter comb over quarters 16..371.5, independently transcribed intro discriminates phase. Estimate only; no listening or stem isolation.
report_limits: Mixed recording spectral features, not isolated drum stems.
No actual listening or count-off ON/OFF playback verification was performed by this analysis.
Printed 117 BPM is authoritative for score; 116.999 BPM is a numerical recording estimate effectively consistent with 117.
First beat is a signal-window fit with 10ms feature hop, not millisecond-accurate ground truth.
Local shifts and nearby peaks are diagnostics only; never applied as individual beat or hit times.
The final 3.89s beyond the 93-measure grid is preserved in the original audio as tail.
Apple STT/AFM was considered unnecessary: this task uses numerical transients; vocal lyric timing is outside scope.
